There is a reaction: 1. TsCl, pyr; 2. NaCN does change pentan-1-ol.

explanation: Two steps: TsCl makes the OH a leaving group (retention), then cyanide does SN2 on the tosylate → one extra carbon as a nitrile. PBr₃ then NaCN works the same way.
tip: OH is a terrible leaving group. Tosylate or bromide first, then the nucleophile.

flaws.why: Step 1 (NaCN) does nothing here: OH is a terrible leaving group; a nucleophile cannot displace it. Make the halide (PBr₃/SOCl₂) or an epoxide first.
